lines.text: For 13 years, a mystery tapping hijacked radios worldwide.

parts.tts: For thirteen years, a mystery tapping hijacked radios worldwide.
parts.heard: for 13 years, a mystery tapping hijacked radios worldwide.

lines.text: July 1976. Shortwave radios suddenly started doing... this.

parts.tts: July nineteen seventy-six. Shortwave radios suddenly started doing...
parts.heard: July 1976. Shortwave radios suddenly started doing.

lines.text: 10 sharp taps a second. Over and over and over.

parts.tts: ten sharp taps a second. Over and over and over.
parts.heard: 10 sharp taps a second, over and over and over.

lines.text: It hopped across frequencies, drowning out broadcasts, ham radio, even aviation.

parts.tts: It hopped across frequencies, drowning out broadcasts, ham radio, even aviation.
parts.heard: It hopped across frequencies, drowning out broadcasts, ham radio, even aviation.

lines.text: Listeners nicknamed it the Russian Woodpecker.

parts.tts: Listeners nicknamed it the Russian Woodpecker.
parts.heard: Listeners nicknamed it the Russian Woodpecker.

lines.text: But here's the part... the Soviet Union never claimed it.

parts.tts: the Soviet Union never claimed it.
parts.heard: The Soviet Union never claimed it.

lines.text: Radio hobbyists and NATO triangulated it to a spot near Chernobyl.

parts.tts: Radio hobbyists and nato triangulated it to a spot near Chernobyl.
parts.heard: Radio hobbyists and NATO triangulated it to a spot near Chernobyl.

lines.text: It was a giant Soviet radar, watching for missiles over the horizon, at over 10 megawatts.

parts.tts: It was a giant Soviet radar, watching for missiles over the horizon, at over ten megawatts.
parts.heard: It was a giant Soviet radar watching for missiles over the horizon at over 10 megawatts.

lines.text: Thousands of complaints poured in. Some radios even came with Woodpecker Blankers, just to block it.

parts.tts: Thousands of complaints poured in. Some radios even came with Woodpecker Blankers, just to block it.
parts.heard: Thousands of complaints poured in. Some radios even came with woodpecker-blankers, just to block it.

parts.tts: In nineteen eighty-nine, the tapping finally stopped.

lines.text: But the giant antenna is still standing, abandoned, in the woods near Chernobyl.

parts.tts: But the giant antenna is still standing, abandoned, in the woods near Chernobyl.
parts.heard: but the giant antenna is still standing, abandoned, in the woods near Chernobyl.
